summary: Namespace capacity reads use one dedicated runner on manual dispatch or an hourly schedule, without starting Workspace CI

replay.detail: No graph replay or stored-state change.

schema.detail: No storage or client schema change.

rules.detail: No claim, retention or checkpoint rules change.

compatibility.detail: Existing capacity artifacts keep their concurrency fields and add an observation timestamp.

manual.detail: Use namespace-capacity.yml instead of fleet.yml for a manual Namespace capacity reading. The dedicated workflow also runs hourly at minute 17 UTC.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or rollback change.
